notes.title: Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
We've watched the let's plays, we've heard the feedback, we've watched the livestreams. 
Tutorials are HERE.

No longer will you have to flock to the interwebs, forums, or Discord to find out what [that thing] does!

GhostProgrammer has ensured he has been able to address most, if not all, of the most common questions that have arisen. So the next time you load up RMR,  you may just learn something new.

We're hard at work on both a roadmap, as well as a BIG monster overhaul, that will replace monster upgrades, evolution, meta progression (not egg level), and then some. Stay tuned for more info.

Lastly, I apologize for the large gap between updates. I lost a friend of mine recently, and it hit me in ways I could not have expected. (No desire to be at or on a computer)  Ghostprogrammer and I have added a little memorial for him in our credits, and a drum kit on the home-screen island, so he may live on forever in our little digital world. RIP Daniel, I miss you dude. Thank you for supporting us with this game, being the funniest person in the room, and always being down for adventure.

To the RMR community, we love and appreciate you all. Hope the tutorials help, and hope you like the monster overhaul we have coming!

Be well.
-Ghost Vibes

notes.title: Post Hatchery QoL Request + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Based on some of your feedback and bug finds, this patch introduces a few things for a better robot crushing experience. 



Bulldoze Mode 

No longer will you accidentally click on a tree in the middle of an insane smite frenzy. Bulldozing trees and rocks now functions differently: Click on the bulldoze icon in the top left (or keyboard shortcut B), then click and hold on a blocked tile to clear it!     

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332876/513597bc04f22a2fa5d6c52f532df5d327dd4acd.gif"]



Gilded Bots 

Golden robots now have a chance of spawning every wave (increased spawn chance the longer you go without seeing them.) They're gold-plated, have increased HP, and drop a nice little gold bonus upon defeat!  



Sound FX bug fix

 The issue with some player abilities not respecting the volume slider has been fixed! Our gift for your ears <3 



QoL Requests

Ability icons now display a number showing the remaining cooldown in seconds - No more guessing based on just the graphic.  

Tile Re-rolls now will try to pick a different connecting path amount. (EG. If you re-roll a 3 path tile, you will likely get a 1 or 2 path tile instead)  

Title screen Logo no longer appears every time you head back to the menu from in-game.  



Welcome to all the new players from the Summer Sale. 

Please join our Discord and help make RMR the best game it can be. We love and appreciate you all!  

-Ghost Vibes Crew

notes.title: The Hatchery Update is HERE!
notes.notes:
Hatchery Update!

It’s finally here. The Hatchery update brings a fun new way to collect and upgrade monsters to Rogue Monster Rush. This update also brings with it a bunch of new player abilities, game optimizations, QoL improvements, and more! Let’s dive in:


The Hatchery and Egg Levels

Spend 3 stars to purchase an egg from the Hatchery. Eggs have a progress bar that is filled passively with XP gained during your runs. Once that XP bar has been filled, your egg is ready to be hatched. Head back to the hatchery to hatch it and see what’s inside!

If you hatch a monster you do not currently have in your collection, you will unlock that monster! However, if you hatch a monster that’s currently in your collection, that monster will gain an Egg level, giving you a selection of 3 potential stat upgrades to choose from. Your chosen upgrade will be permanently added to that monster. You can see your monster’s egg level and affected stats highlighted in purple in your monster menus.

A base upgrade has also been added called Heat Lamps, to reduce the XP needed to hatch eggs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332876/52309d05a3a4c7c291293c7edacef0ebbcf521c5.gif

New Player Abilities + Ability Loadout

Minigun
Click on an open tile to drop into the action in your own minigun. Give your monsters a hard-earned break and unleash a barrage of damage to the enemy robots. (April fools joke gone way too far haha)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332876/252c31a8016cf1db4d57c60922be0eb7d881c046.gif

Blizzard
Cast an onslaught of icy projectiles from above! Each icicle has a chance to freeze enemies in their tracks. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332876/9b1c93674b361899eae0f487e3286f191fc5b19a.gif

Overgrowth
Put your green thumb to work - summon a thicket of bramble to slow and damage enemies who dare try to pass through it. 

Loadout
In your party loadout screen, click on a player ability slot to change it by cycling through your other available ones. Play with different combinations to see which you like best!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332876/64d1f08764905b565b8baedbddf187d052e40703.gif


Advanced Targeting

For all the advanced players looking for a way to really take control of their monsters, we’ve added advanced targeting to the arsenal. Purchase it from the base upgrades and click on your monsters to change their targeting priority.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332876/0af8563707270c0748d25c6872b87fe2452bb45a.gif

Progress = Closest to your base, Proximity = Closest to the monster, Strongest = Highest total HP, Nearest Death = Most missing HP%, Fastest = Highest speed, Slowest = Slowest speed


Various Others

Framerate Lock
Options Menu: Lock FPS to 30/60/Unlimited, really useful for those playing on SteamDeck/Laptops to reduce battery usage.

V-Sync
Eliminate screen tearing, robots LOVE screen tearing.

Delete Save File
With each update, decide whether or not you’d like a fresh experience, click the floppy disk icon in the bottom left corner of the menu screen.

Damage Overhaul
Damage has been overhauled to have point values, for more accurate damage being done, rather than rounding, everything will be scaling much more accurately.

Performance Optimizations
Various fixes and changes to ensure performance stays solid when there’s a lot of mayhem on screen.


Next Milestones:
Balance Pass + UI Refresh + Monster Progression/Perk Card overhaul
New Monsters (Elemental AoE slower + Melee Cleaver)
Biome 2 + Endless Mode
OST as dlc
More info about these soon.


Thank you all so much for playing Rogue Monster Rush, as a small 2-person team your support means the absolute world to us. Please consider joining our Discord, and leaving a Steam review. 

Much love, GLHF.

-GhostVibes Crew

notes.title: Hatchery Update & Milestone
notes.notes:
Hey all!

We have a massive update coming this week, while we're saving the full details of the announcement for the launch post, there are a lot of awesome things to look forward to. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332876/99b1c6132f7199a7567ce618840aa843f3b0e5c4.gif

TLDR;

 Hatchery adds egg purchasing and hatching, which gives your monsters permanent stat upgrades and eventually unlocks new monsters
 Awesome new player abilities
 QoL improvements like frame limiting, vsync, save file clearing
 Performance optimizations


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332876/66578cc983c77d97464cf8d8eade2d184e4bbe50.gif

We're uploading a playtesting build right now, if you'd like to get your hands on it early, just switch to the beta branch and give it a shot! For the best experience, we highly recommend clearing your save and starting fresh!

Fun news as well, we just hit our first 1000 units sold! So a huge thank you to every one of you who joined us on this adventure in our infancy, we appreciate you all and can't wait to show you where RMR is heading.

-Ghost Vibes Crew
